$comment: UI council (docs/ui.md "UI council"): `pnpm ui:council` screenshots the working tree, then each member scores it 1-10 per category next to main and any reference products in apps/web/.visual/references/<product>/*.png. A round passes when every member gives every category at least `target` and rates this branch at least as high as every reference. Members run on the developer's own CLI subscriptions; `model` is required (no default). Reviewers are never told the target.
